statements.text: ADD-03 Q15 responds that Volume II Clause 6.4 states a minimum retention period and that a longer period is optional; VOL-II:6.4 at ADD-02 requires retention 'for not less than seven (7) years'.

evidence.words: Volume II Clause 6.4 states a minimum period. A Bidder may propose a longer period but is not required to do so.
All process data shall be retained for not less than seven (7) years

statements.text: Q15 confirms VOL-II:6.4 as written (seven years is a floor) and does not change its text or obligation.
ADD-03 Q16 states that an assumption limiting or qualifying a Volume V obligation is a qualification to be listed in Form 4-E, and that Volume I Clause 9.6 applies.

evidence.words: An assumption that limits or qualifies an obligation in Volume V is a qualification and shall be listed in Form 4-E. Volume I Clause 9.6 applies.
Form 4-E shall list every deviation, qualification or reservation to Volume V.

statements.text: Q16 interprets 'qualification' in VOL-I:9.6 and Form 4-E to include assumptions in the Technical Proposal that limit or qualify a Volume V obligation; it does not change their text.

ADD-03 Q17 requires each member of an unincorporated JV EPC Contractor to hold a certificate meeting VOL-I:8.3 and to submit a copy of each with Envelope A; VOL-I:8.3 speaks only of 'The proposed EPC Contractor'.

evidence.words: Each member of the joint venture shall hold a certificate that meets Volume I Clause 8.3, and a copy of each certificate shall be submitted with Envelope A.
The proposed EPC Contractor shall hold a valid ISO 9001:2015 quality management certificate

statements.text: Q17 adds an obligation (per-member certification and submission for JV EPC Contractors) beyond the text of VOL-I:8.3, without amending that text.

ADD-03 Q18 states that the nearest sensitive receptor and applicable odour concentration for VOL-II:3.4 as amended by ADD-03 Section 5 are in ESIA Figure 7-2, and no other modelling inputs will be provided.

evidence.words: are shown in Figure 7-2 of the Environmental and Social Impact Assessment, which is available to Bidders in the data room. No other modelling inputs will be provided.
Odour control shall achieve not more than 5 OU/m³ at the site boundary, assessed as a 98th percentile hourly value.

statements.text: Q18 is informational/interpretive for VOL-II:3.4 (as to be amended by ADD-03:5.1, another batch); it changes no text.

ADD-03 Q19 states the Form 4-F Availability Payment is the year-1 amount in year-1 prices and that indexation under Volume V Clause 29.2 applies from the first anniversary of PCOD; ADD-03:3.3 (another batch) substitutes Clause 29.2 with text that indexes 'annually from the Base Date'.

evidence.words: The Availability Payment stated in Form 4-F is the amount payable for year 1 of operations, in the prices of that year. Indexation under Volume V Clause 29.2 applies from the first anniversary of PCOD.

The Availability Payment shall be indexed annually from the Base Date in accordance with Schedule 9.
